# IBL-Core

> IBL-Core develops and supports open neuroscience software, data infrastructure, experimental tools, and collaborative research projects.

Use the canonical pages below for current public information about IBL-Core.

## Main

- [IBL-Core home](https://iblcore.org/): Mission, areas of work, selected major publications, funders, and contact information.

## About

- [Our Team](https://iblcore.org/about/team/): IBL-Core staff and the principal investigator scientific board.
- [History](https://iblcore.org/about/history/): Background and development of IBL-Core.
- [Strategic Priorities](https://iblcore.org/about/strategic-priorities/): Scientific themes, methodological commitments, and values for 2026-2029.
- [FAQ](https://iblcore.org/about/faq/): Frequently asked questions about IBL-Core.
- [Support](https://iblcore.org/about/support/): Funding and support information.
- [Contact](https://iblcore.org/about/team/#contact): How to contact IBL-Core.

## Resources

- [Resources](https://iblcore.org/resources/): Searchable index of every IBL dataset, tool, hardware item and protocol, filterable by modality, stage of work, type, and data access route.
- [Workflows](https://iblcore.org/resources/workflows/): Step-by-step paths through the resources, from a goal to the tools that get you there.
- [Explore and analyse IBL data](https://iblcore.org/resources/workflows/explore-ibl-data/): Choosing an access route, choosing a dataset, finding sessions, and visualising what you load.

### Datasets

- [Datasets](https://iblcore.org/resources/data/): Every released IBL dataset, with the access routes available for each.
- [Brainwide Map](https://iblcore.org/resources/data/brainwide-map/): 699 Neuropixels insertions across 241 brain areas during decision-making, with access guides and the data explorer.
- [Reproducible Ephys](https://iblcore.org/resources/data/reproducible-ephys/): Multi-lab Neuropixels dataset testing the reproducibility of electrophysiology recordings.
- [Behavior](https://iblcore.org/resources/data/behavior/): Behavioral data from mice learning and performing IBL's standardized visual decision-making task.
- [Widefield](https://iblcore.org/resources/data/widefield/): Widefield calcium imaging data collected across the IBL lab network.
- [Ephys Autism](https://iblcore.org/resources/data/ephys-autism/): Neuropixels recordings from autism model mice performing the standardized decision-making task.

### Tools and data access routes

- [Tools](https://iblcore.org/resources/tools/): Software IBL builds and uses, from acquisition to analysis and visualisation.
- [ONE](https://iblcore.org/resources/tools/one/): IBL's Python API for querying and loading its datasets directly, with full QC and metadata access.
- [DANDI & NWB](https://iblcore.org/resources/tools/dandi/): IBL datasets packaged as NWB on the DANDI Archive, as stable, citable releases.
- [IBL-AI-Agent](https://iblcore.org/resources/tools/ibl-ai-agent/): An agent-driven route that downloads a compressed, analysis-ready subset of IBL data from a plain-language description.
- [Alyx](https://iblcore.org/resources/tools/alyx/): The database of experiment metadata behind IBL's recordings, which ONE queries to find sessions.
- [IBL Sorter](https://iblcore.org/resources/tools/ibl-sorter/): IBL's spike sorting pipeline, turning raw Neuropixels electrophysiology into sorted units.
- [Lightning Pose](https://iblcore.org/resources/tools/lightning-pose/): Semi-supervised 2D and 3D pose estimation, used to track animal movement in video recordings.
- [Datoviz](https://iblcore.org/resources/tools/datoviz/): High-performance GPU rendering for scientific data visualisation of large datasets.

## Projects, publications, and news

- [IBL Research Projects](https://iblcore.org/projects/): Current IBL research projects.
- [Partners and Affiliates](https://iblcore.org/new-partner-projects/): Collaborative partner projects and affiliate research groups working with IBL-Core, in list and map views.
- [Publications](https://iblcore.org/publications/): Selected scientific and technical publications, with keyword filters.
- [Events](https://iblcore.org/events/): Approved outreach events in calendar, list, and map views, with Upcoming and Past filters.
- [News](https://iblcore.org/news/): News, features, and press coverage about the International Brain Laboratory.

## Optional

- [International Brain Laboratory GitHub](https://github.com/int-brain-lab/): Public source code and technical repositories.
